s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive swelling of the manubrium with a history of previous thyroid surgery
salient_findings: Lytic lesion replacing the manubrium on CT imaging
Follicular thyroid cells on fine-needle aspiration
key_facts: Patient is a man in his 70s
Previous resection of a large left substernal thyroid lobe 12 years ago
Swelling of the manubrium is slightly tender
Swelling increased in size over the month prior to presentation
CT imaging shows a lytic lesion replacing the manubrium
Lytic lesion is in close proximity to the brachiocephalic artery and the left innominate vein
Fine-needle aspiration revealed follicular thyroid cells
Pathological examination shows thyroid follicles infiltrating adjacent to bone trabeculae

raw.champion: Follicular thyroid carcinoma with distant metastasis
raw.rationale: The presence of a lytic lesion in the manubrium with follicular thyroid cells on fine-needle aspiration and pathological examination showing thyroid follicles infiltrating adjacent to bone trabeculae, along with a history of previous thyroid surgery, suggests metastasis from a primary thyroid cancer.

rejected.label: Ectopic thyroid tissue
rejected.why: Ectopic thyroid tissue is unlikely to cause a lytic lesion and would not typically show the aggressive features seen in this case.

rejected.label: Follicular thyroid carcinoma
rejected.why: While follicular thyroid carcinoma is a possible diagnosis, the presence of a distant lesion in the manubrium suggests metastasis, making 'Follicular thyroid carcinoma with distant metastasis' a more comprehensive explanation.

rejected.label: Thyroid metastasis to the sternum
rejected.why: This option is less specific than 'Follicular thyroid carcinoma with distant metastasis', which provides more information about the primary tumor.

rejected.label: Ectopic thyroid carcinoma in the manubrium
rejected.why: The history of previous thyroid surgery and the presence of follicular thyroid cells in the manubrial lesion suggest a metastatic origin rather than a primary ectopic thyroid carcinoma.

gold: Follicular thyroid carcinoma with manubrial invasion
